results.reason: No author-maintained implementation was found and the paper's public-code claim could not be independently retrieved.

limitations: Only three attack campaigns are available; the held-out target has one positive episode per domain.
The official B-CITD scripts were not run unchanged because they require CERT4.2 files and PyTorch Geometric; adapters are explicitly labeled.
DS-IID has no independently retrievable official code and is NOT_MEASURED.
Episode-level and target metrics have wide uncertainty; claims are inconclusive without additional generation runs.
